content:
Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (b) Central Government employees may be allowed to go on deputation to State Governments/ UTs or on foreign service to any entity controlled by and located in above states/ UTs on spouse ground after completion of 6 years of service in the cadre.  
Only cases covered by above dispensation will be considered for relaxation with effect from 18-10-2018.Order (18), Section I, Appendix 5.
